_about: Recreational finfish size and daily limits, hand-entered from MPI area pages and the Fisheries (Recreational Management Controls) Notice No.1 2026. Guide only. verified:true only where Forecast Brain's second check (27 Oct 2026) matched the sources. Built by scripts/catch-rules/build.py.
